text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria will supply 25 percent of European gas needs by year 2000. Algerian gas pipeline to Spain via Morocco and the Strait of Gibraltar will pen soon.
- Ten "terrorists" killed by security forces in three operations in Algiers.
- National Liberation Front supports referendum to amend the constitution.
- The Transitional National Council will vote an Arabic language law in November.
- Aissa Hayatou, president of the African Football Confederation, says any African soccer team will be punished for rejecting to play game scheduled in Algeria.
- The Transitional National Council debates state budget for 1997.
